svg.title: Прыжки на носках — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Two phases of low-amplitude pogo hops, full side view. Draw the same thin unobtrusive horizontal floor line below each figure at identical height. START body tall, both balls of feet in contact with line, heels slightly raised, knees only slightly soft. FINISH same tall posture and straight-ish legs, both shoes visibly a few inches ABOVE floor line, ankles plantarflexed toes point down. No box, no weights, no deep squat or big forward leap. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
